QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Strong Wind
QuestInfo.0: The moment Alika picked up the Jellyrash, a fierce wind began to blow. It blasted you up to the treetops before you even knew what was happening. What should you do?!
QuestInfo.1:
The moment Alika picked up the Jellyrash, a fierce wind began to blow. It blasted you up to the treetops before you even knew what was happening. You've got to figure out how to get back down to the ground!
You can move by riding the wind.
